messages:
ashley: seeing a p99 spike in hosted-us-west1 from ~2300->1800ms, started ~3950004300. p95 also up but smaller.
leo: any specific tenant or model hot?
ashley: looks correlated to tenant T-424, request rate jumped and queue depth rose. request backlogs spiking to 48 per worker.
maria: we pushed a batching sampler tweak ~20m before spike FWIW.
jon: i pulled kernel_selector logs: many requests got routed to aux_kernel_v2 around the spike window. latency for that kernel ~1.1s on 8k seqs vs fast_kernel ~250ms.
ashley: ugh. kernel_selector output snippet:
```
2026-03-18T12:05:02Z INFO route req_id=... tenant=T-424 selected_kernel=aux_kernel_v2 reason=mem_estimate_high
2026-03-18T12:05:02Z INFO kvcache evict tenant=T-424 evict_count=312 new_size=0.42
2026-03-18T12:05:03Z WARN batch_sampler delay_ms=120 route=aux_kernel_v2
```
leo: mem_estimate_high -> might be due to KV cache churn. can you dump kvcache stats?
ashley: paste from /metrics endpoint:
```
redwood_kvcache_entries_total{tenant="T-424"} 1024
redwood_kvcache_evictions_total{tenant="T-424"} 312
redwood_kvcache_hit_ratio{tenant="T-424"} 0.18
redwood_kernel_select_count{kernel="fast_kernel"} 1200
redwood_kernel_select_count{kernel="aux_kernel_v2"} 870
```
jon: hit_ratio 0.18 is terrible. looks like a noisy neighbor pattern where one tenant's large short-lived contexts thrash KV.
maria: the batching sampler change reduced max_batch_bytes heuristic; could be creating many small batches and raising memory pressure.
leo: can we confirm per-tenant memory usage on the serving host?
ashley: host-level GPU mem for the pod that served T-424 shot from 6.2G -> 10.4G (out of 12G) around spike.
ops-bot: incident: hosted-us-west1 p99 spike detected -> incident:INC-2026-0418 created.
sre-bot: linked runbook: /runbooks/latency-hosted-p99. suggested mitigations: tenant rate-limit, kernel-fallback-override, increase kvcache capacity.
jon: immediate mitigation: rate-limit T-424 to 50 rps and pin their routes to fast_kernel for 10m. that should reduce tail.
maria: i can revert the sampler tweak in canary; rolling back now.
ashley: applying rate-limit patch:
```bash
redwoodctl tenants update T-424 --rate-limit 50
redwoodctl routing set T-424 --kernel=fast_kernel --duration=10m
```
leo: thanks. we should also increase kvcache pin size for high-hit tenants but T-424 is low-hit. consider tenant isolation for embedding-heavy workloads.
jon: after rate-limit + pin, p99 dropped to ~320ms within 90s. queue depth back to ~6.
ashley: confirm: after changes /metrics now: 
```
redwood_kvcache_evictions_total{tenant="T-424"} 318
redwood_kvcache_hit_ratio{tenant="T-424"} 0.23
redwood_request_queue_depth{host="h-07"} 6
redwood_latency_p99{region="us-west1"} 0.32
```
maria: rollback pushed to canary, will promote if stable. main followups: add a guard in kernel_selector to avoid switching to aux if estimated batch latency > 600ms; improve sampler heuristics to account for ephemeral short-lived contexts; add per-tenant kvcache quotas and a pin API.
leo: please open issues and assign owners. also run a postmortem: include timeline, graphs, and the kernel_selector trace.
jon: created issue INF-2091: "aux_kernel misroute under noisy-tenant causing p99 spike" assigned to eng-runtime, priority P1. linked PR for temporary kernel-selection guard INF-2091-pr1.
ops-bot: action taken: rate-limit T-424 (50 rps), pinned kernel fast_kernel for 10m, rollback sampler canary rolled back. incident status: mitigation applied.
ashley: closing loop: will monitor for 2 hours then mark incident resolved if no reoccurrence. great work everyone :thumbsup:
leo: follow-up items: long-term tenant isolation (dedicated pools); optimize aux_kernel perf or avoid misrouting; add better eviction metrics for alerting.
jon: adding test for kernel_selector: simulate heavy eviction + sampling churn to see decision boundaries.
maria: i'll write a short runbook update about sampler config and deployment checklist.
ashley: thanks all — marking thread resolved but keeping incident open until end of watch window.
